Platform Guide
==============

This section covers everything you can do from the CranL dashboard at `app.cranl.com <https://app.cranl.com>`_.

The dashboard is organized around **projects** — each project groups related applications, databases, and team members together.

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 30 70

   * - Feature
     - Description
   * - :doc:`projects`
     - Create and manage projects
   * - :doc:`github-integration`
     - Connect GitHub and sync repositories
   * - :doc:`applications`
     - Create and configure applications
   * - :doc:`deployments`
     - Deploy, view build logs, AI fix
   * - :doc:`environment-variables`
     - Manage app environment variables
   * - :doc:`domains-ssl`
     - Custom domains and SSL certificates
   * - :doc:`databases`
     - Provision managed databases
   * - :doc:`monitoring`
     - CPU, memory, and disk usage
   * - :doc:`analytics`
     - Traffic analytics and insights
   * - :doc:`schedules`
     - Cron jobs for recurring tasks
   * - :doc:`storage`
     - S3-compatible object storage
   * - :doc:`team-members`
     - Invite members and manage roles
   * - :doc:`billing`
     - Subscription plans and payments
   * - :doc:`settings`
     - Profile, API keys, organization
